content.title: SM Energy (SM): Margin Compression Challenges Bullish Value Narrative Despite 47% Five-Year Earnings Growth
content.summary: SM Energy (SM) reported annual earnings growth of 47% over the past five years, signaling a return to profitability. In the latest year, however, earnings growth slowed to just 0.2%, with net profit margins compressing to 27.1% from 34.3% the prior year. Looking ahead, the company faces expectations of 14.6% annual earnings decline over the next three years, with revenue growth forecast at 2.6% per year, trailing the broader US market. content.title: SM Energy to Buy Civitas for $2.8 Billion
content.summary: Oil-and-gas producer SM Energy announced a roughly $2.8 billion agreement to acquire rival Civitas Resources.  SM said on Monday that it was merging with Civitas in an all-stock transaction that seeks to give the companies scale and help them pay down their debt faster.  Civitas's share price fell 1.5%.
